messages:
Jill K: On call now with customer; their bulk embeddings import got a flood of 429s and the demo froze. They were trying to speed up by firing many small requests concurrently.
Marco D: Which route and tenant?
Jill K: /v1/embeddings, tenant: beta-corp (trial). Stack trace from SDK: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests, x-request-id=aa11bb22, X-RateLimit-Remaining=0, X-RateLimit-Reset=27
Ana R: ops-bot: pull tenant quota snapshot for beta-corp
ops-bot: tenant=beta-corp snapshot: global_budget=100000, used_10m=96000, per_route("/v1/embeddings").burst=0, inflight_limit=20
Marco D: 100 concurrent small requests will exhaust the burst budget—trial accounts have tight global budgets + per-route burst enforcement.
Priya S: Two short fixes: 1) temporary quota bump for the demo (sales request) 2) change client to limit concurrency to ~8 and use larger batched payloads
Jill K: Sales asking for a 150k temporary bump for 2 hours so they can finish POC. Can ops do scoped bump?
Ana R: I can apply a timed bump to the trial pool: +150000 tokens, duration 7200s. Applying now.
ops-bot: quota update applied: new_global_budget=250000, expires=2499997260
Marco D: Also flag for DevEx: add note in quickstart that imports should prefer fewer requests with larger batches for trial accounts.
Jill K: Customer retried and finished import after we bumped. They were relieved. Sending follow-up email now.
Priya S: Follow-ups: (1) Sales to ask if they want extended trial quota or dedicated demo cluster. (2) Engineering: clearer 429 response that includes retry-after and hint about trial limits. (3) DevEx: sample client concurrency recommendations.
Jill K: I'll collect logs and X-Request-IDs and drop them to #eng-ops for postmortem. Closing for now, will reopen if they requeue.
